description: Plan an A/B test: visitors needed per variant to detect the smallest lift that matters (mde) at a given power, and/or the smallest lift detectable with a given n_per_variant; days needed from daily_traffic. Conversion: baseline_rate. Continuous: baseline_sd (and baseline_mean for a relative mde). Use in an exploration (planning a future test); a running hypothesis test sizes itself in step 4.

adjust_for_variants.description: Split α across the comparisons with the control (Bonferroni) when there are 3+ variants.

alternative.description: two-sided (default), greater (first > second / sample > value), or less.

mde.description: Smallest lift that matters: absolute (0.005 = +0.5 percentage points) or relative with mde_type "relative" (0.1 = +10%).

name: ab_test_plan
title: A/B test sample size
